instruments.notes: Participating forward swap; floor $2.10 per MMbtu and re-entry price $2.48 per MMbtu (re-entry price not mapped to a ceiling). Total fair value of all open derivative contracts at 12/31/1998 was $0.1 million (not split by contract).
instruments.evidence_quote: In April 1997, Penn Virginia executed a contract for a participating forward swap for 5,000 Mmbtu's per day with a floor price of $2.10 per MMbtu and a re-entry price of $2.48 per MMbtu for the period of May 1997 through October 1999.

instruments.notes: Second participating forward swap, additional 5,000 Mmbtu per day; floor $2.10 per MMbtu and re-entry price $2.35 per MMbtu (re-entry price not mapped to a ceiling). Total fair value of all open derivative contracts at 12/31/1998 was $0.1 million (not split by contract).
instruments.evidence_quote: In September 1997, the Company completed a second participating forward swap for an additional 5,000 Mmbtu's per day with a floor price of $2.10 per MMbtu and a re-entry price of $2.35 per MMbtu for the period of November 1997 through October 1999.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Price risk program permits futures, forwards, options and swaps to mitigate natural gas price risk on anticipated production; designated as hedges. Has not hedged crude oil prices.
